name: Asylum / Refugee Status

requirements.blocker_text: The Migration and Citizenship Service (MCS) -- Armenia's own national asylum authority, not UNHCR directly -- assesses the risks faced in the applicant's country of origin and the reasons they cannot return, following a mandatory registration and interview. Standard review takes 3 months from submission, extendable to 6 months; an accelerated procedure for manifestly unfounded claims takes 10 working days, extendable to 1 month. Negative decisions are appealable in all three court instances.

evidence_required.document: Asylum application registered with the MCS
Mandatory interview testimony on risks/reasons for not returning

outcome.duration_length: not fully confirmed in this pass -- an asylum-seeker's ID card during the procedure and a Convention Travel Document upon recognition were referenced but their specific validity periods were not confirmed

sources.title: UNHCR Armenia -- confirms Armenia's Migration and Citizenship Service (MCS) is the national authority determining refugee status directly (UNHCR supports but does not run the procedure): registration, mandatory interview, 3-month standard/6-month extended decision timeline, 10-working-day/1-month accelerated procedure for manifestly unfounded claims, 3-court-instance appeal

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Armenia). Unlike Morocco's and Oman's structures built earlier in this dataset, Armenia's own government agency runs refugee status determination directly under national law -- not UNHCR, and not a discretionary sovereign act. work_rights modeled 'restricted' and outcome duration left partially unconfirmed since the specific validity periods of the asylum-seeker ID card and post-recognition Convention Travel Document referenced by the source were not detailed on the page fetched -- disclosed as a gap rather than guessed. pr_after_months and citizenship_after_months reuse the general 3-year figures from am_permanent_residence.json and am_naturalisation.json since no refugee-specific reduced track was found.
